do_pattern: position: sticky; top: 0; backdrop-blur on scroll
dont_pattern: Fixed full-height sidebar on mobile kills content area

do_pattern: 5-6 max items with clear hierarchy + CTA button
dont_pattern: 10+ nav items no visual hierarchy overwhelms users

do_pattern: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { animation: none }
dont_pattern: Forced animations for all users causes motion sickness

do_pattern: transition: all 200ms ease-in-out on hover states
dont_pattern: 1000ms+ transitions feel sluggish on interactive elements

do_pattern: <label> above <input> persistent not placeholder-only
dont_pattern: Placeholder-as-label disappears on focus user forgets context

rule: Show validation inline not on submit
do_pattern: Real-time border-color change + helper text below input
dont_pattern: Wait until form submit to show all errors at once

do_pattern: Stack inputs vertically max-width 480px centered
dont_pattern: Two-column forms reduce completion rate 20%

rule: Minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for body text
do_pattern: Check with WebAIM contrast checker use dark text on light bg
dont_pattern: Light grey text #999 on white bg fails WCAG AA

rule: Never use color alone to convey meaning
do_pattern: Icon + color + text for error states
dont_pattern: Red border only to indicate error invisible to colorblind

do_pattern: loading="lazy" on all img tags below viewport
dont_pattern: Eager-loading all images kills LCP score mobile

do_pattern: Automatic WebP AVIF conversion responsive sizes
dont_pattern: Serving 2MB JPEG unoptimized kills Core Web Vitals

rule: One primary CTA per section maximum
do_pattern: Single high-contrast button clear action verb
dont_pattern: 3+ CTAs per section decision paralysis reduces clicks

rule: Action verbs on buttons not nouns
do_pattern: Start Free Trial Get My Photos Download Now
dont_pattern: Button Submit Free Trial generic no motivation

do_pattern: line-height: 1.6 on p elements font-size: 16-18px
dont_pattern: Tight line-height 1.2 on body text feels cramped unreadable

do_pattern: max-width: 65ch on paragraphs
dont_pattern: Full-width text lines on desktop eyes lose tracking

do_pattern: margin/padding in multiples of 8: 8 16 24 32 40 48 64
dont_pattern: Random spacing values 13px 22px 37px no visual rhythm

do_pattern: min-height: 44px min-width: 44px on all interactive elements
dont_pattern: Small 20x20px tap targets cause misclicks high frustration

do_pattern: Fixed bottom nav bar 5 items max thumb-friendly
dont_pattern: Top navigation on mobile requires one-handed stretch

rule: Show real numbers not vague claims
dont_pattern: 247 customers served in 89 countries
severity: Thousands of satisfied customers no specifics

do_pattern: Skeleton placeholder matching content layout
dont_pattern: Blank white screen with spinner feels broken

do_pattern: Show most expensive tier first makes middle feel reasonable
dont_pattern: Show cheapest first anchors expectation too low

do_pattern: Border shadow badge Most Popular on middle tier
dont_pattern: All tiers look identical no visual hierarchy

do_pattern: Something went wrong with your payment. Try again or contact support.
dont_pattern: Error 422: Unprocessable Entity
